description: This file defines the LeaveModel class within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It serves as a data model for leave-related information, including properties like id, date, status, leave type, time, duration, and comments. The class uses traits for serialization and prepares the model with specific filters and attribute mappings for API responses.

classes.name: LeaveModel
classes.description: Represents the leave data model in the API, including properties for leave details, status, type, timing, and comments, with serialization logic for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveModel instance with a Leave entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
